goal: Add and verify the exact-artifact GitHub Pages path required for Stage 1 without changing game behavior.
terminal_condition: One amended local candidate commit is frozen after Fable 5 Max verifies the bounded diff, required tests, build identity, artifact digest, workflow security, and no-deploy boundary.
required_tests: VITE_BUILD_SHA set to a 40-character test SHA during npm run build
built HTML contains the full SHA metadata and mount-independent asset paths
workflow structure proves a single build and no deploy-time rebuild
required_security_evidence: build job has read-only contents permission
deploy job alone has pages write and id-token write permissions
no credential or private data enters the artifact
the uploaded dist is the artifact consumed by the dependent deploy job
merge_eligibility_conditions: current exact-head GitHub CI is green
deployed artifact SHA and digest match the frozen candidate
stopping_conditions: scope requires game behavior, secrets, or broader permissions
